title: JointQ: Joint Scale-and-Integer Quantization for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. translated_title: JointQ：面向大语言模型的尺度与整数联合量化
translated_abstract: GPTQ 是大语言模型逐层训练后量化（PTQ）的事实标准求解器，然而求解器本身所受到的关注却少于权重预处理和跨层目标。我们针对 GPTQ 的一个瓶颈：其贪心过程将连续的组尺度优化与离散整数的分配分开进行。“结合闭式最优尺度来评估每个整数候选”的做法已被用于逐通道量化；JointQ 将其扩展到分组量化——其中同一行的各尺度通过 Hessian 矩阵相互耦合——并用它来改进 GPTQ 的解。每次局部搜索移动改变一个整数，并以闭式形式重新计算其所在组的最优尺度，同时通过完整的 Hessian 矩阵考虑其他组的影响；所有尺度还会周期性地被联合重新求解。该搜索从包括 GPTQ 解在内的、经过尺度重拟合的候选中进行逐行选择开始，因此未加正则化的 JointQ 从不……
tldr: 提出 JointQ，一种将连续组尺度与离散整数分配联合优化的量化求解器，通过基于闭式最优尺度重计算的局部搜索来改进 GPTQ 的解，从而提升大语言模型训练后量化的精度。
en_tdlr: JointQ jointly optimizes continuous group scales and discrete integer assignments, using local search with closed-form optimal scale recomputation to refine the GPTQ solution and improve post-training quantization accuracy for large language models.
